explanation: The statement is about library-only objects: `pairF` (the Petersson/parabolic pairing on H^1 of congruence subgroups, defined in Def_ModularCurve_PDPairing.lean), the corestriction `cores` / restriction `res` for `Additive Φ →+ R`, the predicate `IsPar`, `normConj`, `coresFun`, plus the hypothesis `hnorm` on normal cores. I searched Mathlib for `pairF`, `IsPar`, `cores`/`res` analogues and found none: Mathlib only has `IsParabolic` (a matrix/GL predicate), `pairFunction` (a limit-shape functor), `Subgroup.relIndex`/`index` (used only in the last line via `Subgroup.relIndex, Subgroup.index_eq_card`), and generic `MonoidHom`/`AddMonoidHom` API. The mathematical content (the behaviour of the parabolic pairing under corestriction of the first variable to a normal subgroup, giving a factor `relIndex Γ'`) does not exist in Mathlib, so there is no declaration to duplicate or specialize.
